news.title: SpaceX将以600亿美元收购AI编程初创公司Cursor
news.snippet: 马斯克旗下SpaceX拟斥资600亿美元收购AI编程工具Cursor，创下年度最大并购案之一。
news.raw_snippet: # SpaceX to acquire the AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion. * SpaceX announced it will acquire the AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion. * The Cursor deal will help to bolster the company's efforts to compete with rivals like Anthropic and OpenAI, which also offer popular coding tools. * SpaceX expects the merger to close during the third quarter of this year, according to a filing. Musk merged SpaceX with his AI startup, xAI, earlier this year, and the Cursor deal will help to bolster the company's efforts to compete with rivals like Anthropic and OpenAI, which also offer popular coding tools. SpaceX expects the merger to close during the third quarter of this year, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. In April, SpaceX said it had obtained the right to acquire Cursor for $60 billion later this year. ## More In AI Age. news.title: AI重塑全球并购市场格局
news.snippet: 人工智能技术正在改变全球并购(M&A)市场，推动交易模式变革，韩国每日经济报分析这一趋势对商业的影响。
news.raw_snippet: # Maeil Business Newspaper Korea's No. 1 Economic Media. # Maeil Business News Korea. ## As artificial intelligence (AI) changes the market for global mergers and acquisitions (M&A), th.. As artificial intelligence (AI) changes the market for global mergers and acquisitions (M&A), the "AI-derived M&A supercycle" is being driven. Global M&A has already reached about 4,000 trillion won this year as companies are trying to secure core technologies, talents, and infrastructure in order not to lose the initiative in the AI era. According to Reuters on the 16th (local time), Goldman Sachs' cumulative advisory transaction in the global M&A market exceeded $1 trillion (about 1,370 trillion won) in the first half of this year. It is the first time in Wall Street's history that the half-year M&A advisory has exceeded $1 trillion based on the tally of market research firm Dealogic.

news.title: IPO后高歌猛进，SpaceX拟60亿美元收购AI初创公司
news.snippet: SpaceX在首次公开募股(IPO)后市值飙升，现计划斥资60亿美元收购AI编程工具Cursor，扩张AI版图。
news.raw_snippet: # Riding High After I.P.O., SpaceX to Buy A.I. Start-Up for $60 Billion. SpaceX exercised its option to acquire Cursor in an all-stock deal, bolstering Elon Musk’s ambitions in artificial intelligence. SpaceX said on Tuesday that it would acquire the parent company of Cursor, an artificial intelligence code-writing start-up, for $60 billion, just days after Elon Musk’s rocket and A.I. company made its record-breaking public market debut. SpaceX agreed to a deal with Cursor in April that gave it the option to acquire the company, an arrangement that would “allow us to build the world’s most useful” A.I. models, SpaceX said at the time. It pushed ahead with an all-stock acquisition of Anysphere, the parent of Cursor, after SpaceX’s initial public offering last week. SpaceX’s main business has been building rocket ships and offering satellite internet, but Mr. Musk has increasingly expanded his empire to take advantage of the A.I. boom. news.title: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋：社会必须适应人工智能
news.snippet: NVIDIA首席执行官Jensen Huang强调，随着AI技术快速发展，社会必须调整结构和文化以适应这一变革。
news.raw_snippet: National News |   Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says society needs…. # Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says society needs ‘new social norms’ in the age of AI. ## The head of the world’s most valuable company said society will adapt to AI just as it did to automobiles. SHERMAN, Texas (AP) — Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — whose work helped propel artificial intelligence — stressed in an Associated Press interview Tuesday that society needs to change with the advent of AI, arguing that a fuller embrace of the technology would improve people’s lives. Huang made his case as AI has emerged as a political flashpoint, with objections to plans to build more data centers and fears that the speed with which it’s being adopted could spur the layoffs of workers who might not have a safety net. Huang contended that there is a need for some government regulation and safety standards for AI, emphasizing that national security also needed to be a priority for the technology that has been powering stock market gains and U.S. economic growth in recent years.
